quarterly_data.signal: Amkor's 10-K reports 2025 capital expenditures of $904.6 million (13.5% of net sales) versus $743.8 million (11.8% of net sales) in 2024, primarily for advanced packaging and test equipment and the Arizona Facility, whose construction began in the second half of 2025; it also continues to scale production at its Vietnam facility, opened in 2024. As of December 31, 2025, off-balance sheet purchase obligations for capital expenditures, long-term supply contracts and other contractual commitments were $1,152.4 million, with $1,084.8 million payable within 12 months, and future minimum payments under long-term materials supply contracts for 2026 through 2035 are $12.1 million.
